newsitem.title: GREECE: OLYMPICS-IOC PRES SAMARANCH TO PLANT OLIVE TREE IN ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-IOC PRES SAMARANCH TO PLANT OLIVE TREE IN ATHENS.

text.p: International Olympic Committee president Juan Antonio Samaranch is in Athens to participate in the 37th International Olympics Academy (IOA) conference at Pnyka.

Earlier, Samaranch will plant an olive tree bearing his name at the IOC-members park during a ceremony attended by the Greek cabinet, Athens mayor Dimitris Avramopoulos and Athens 2004 bid committee president Yanna Angelopoulos.
Athens, Rome, Stockholm, Cape Town and Buenos Aires are on the final shortlist of cities bidding to host the 2004 Olympic Games. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
